proposals.name: Explain-it-like-I'm-five science
evidence: YouTube search interest for kid-science explainers rising 6 months (https://example.invalid/e2)
proposals.fit_rationale: Gramps' voice is built for it; educational pull is evergreen for family co-viewing.
example_uses: Description hook phrased as a question kids ask

selection.decision_note: TR02 only; TR01 revisit next episode.

story_plan.approach: Gramps answers Milo's mid-peril questions with 5-second gadget-side science bits, always in character, always mid-action.
story_plan.subtlety_test: Trend-aware viewers recognize the explainer rhythm; trend-blind viewers just see Gramps being Gramps — the beats work as pure comedy.
